title: Shared voice building blocks
description: Definitions shared by the messages of the voice session socket (master plan 13 and 14.2), referenced as urn:alixai:schema:voice:shared:v1#/$defs/<name>. This file is a definitions library: it constrains nothing on its own.

audioFormat.title: Audio format
audioFormat.description: Raw PCM, the only encoding the voice seam carries: signed 16-bit little-endian, interleaved when there is more than one channel. Containers and codecs (WAV, Opus, MP3) are the client's business; the core never parses an untrusted media format.

language.title: Language tag
language.description: A BCP 47 language tag such as en, it or it-IT.

utteranceId.title: Utterance ID
utteranceId.description: ID of one spoken or submitted utterance, minted by the core when the capture starts or the audio is submitted.

playbackId.title: Playback ID
playbackId.description: ID of one playback of verified response speech, minted by the core.

voiceSessionId.title: Voice session ID
voiceSessionId.description: ID of one voice connection, minted by the core. It is not the conversation session: voice and text share the session the context token names.

effect.title: Degradation effect
effect.description: What the user loses when a voice component is not available (master plan 18): text_input_only (no speech recognition: type instead), verified_text_only (no speech synthesis: the verified text is shown, not spoken), manual_turn_taking (no voice-activity detection: the client ends each capture).

speakerHint.title: Speaker hint
speakerHint.description: What an optional speaker-recognition component believes about who spoke. It is a convenience for the host's interface (a greeting, a highlighted name) and nothing else: it is never an identity, never a permission, never a confirmation and never changes the scope the utterance runs under, which is the verified context token's.
